name: Hélène Riesenberg
source: Detective Hélène Riesenberg is a detective and special agent at the Republican General Intelligence. Formerly stationed in the tropical nation of Cosagoria, she is now eager to use Carola to get to the bottom of a communist conspiracy brewing in the nation of Ranalt.
